title: TSAI Trust Authority Operational Status Report Payload
description: Decoded payload of the compact ES256 JWS published at /.well-known/tsai-ta-status (Section 7.10.2). Aggregate metrics only; no individual credential, agent, or operator identifier.

iss.description: Trust Authority issuer identifier; MUST equal the trusted TA iss

iat.description: Whole-second JWT NumericDate when the report was issued

exp.description: Whole-second JWT NumericDate after which the report MUST NOT be accepted; no more than 24 hours after iat

reportingPeriod.description: Period covered by the aggregate metrics, an ISO 8601 duration such as PT24H

issuedInPeriod.description: Credentials issued during the reporting period

blockedInPeriod.description: Agents or operators blocked during the reporting period

lastKeyRotation.description: When the credential-signing key was last rotated, RFC 3339
